description: POST /audio/speech answers with raw audio bytes under `audio/*` (audio/mpeg, audio/pcm, … by requested format) and GET /videos/{jobId}/content with raw `video/mp4` bytes. The converter only reads binary success bodies declared as `application/octet-stream`, so both are re-keyed to it; the actual Content-Type still varies on the wire and the SDK returns the bytes as a Uint8Array regardless. Source: https://openrouter.ai/openapi.json (fetched 2026-10-05).
